scenarios.name: Interactive URL Shortening Demo
scenarios.description: Verify the interactive URL shortening demo allows visitors to shorten URLs without registration and displays appropriate messaging

steps.description: Load the homepage as an unauthenticated visitor
steps.context: User is not logged in and visiting for the first time

steps.description: Scroll to or identify the interactive demo section on the page
steps.context: Demo section should be prominently displayed below the hero section

steps.description: Enter a valid URL in the demo input field
steps.context: Input field should accept standard URL formats

steps.description: Click the 'Shorten' button to process the URL
steps.context: Button should have appropriate loading state

steps.description: Confirm shortened URL preview is displayed with registration encouragement message
steps.context: Clear indication this is a demo/preview, not a permanent link

test_cases.expected: Shortened URL preview displayed with message encouraging registration for permanent links
User-friendly error message displayed indicating invalid URL format
Validation error shown requiring URL input

test_cases.input: Click shorten button with valid URL
test_cases.expected: Loading state displayed on button during processing
Input field, shorten button, and result area are present and accessible

scenarios.name: Platform Statistics Display
scenarios.description: Verify aggregated platform statistics are displayed with animated counters showing total URLs shortened and clicks tracked

steps.description: Load the homepage to view statistics section
steps.context: Statistics should be visible to all visitors

steps.description: Scroll to the statistics section on the page
steps.context: Section should be positioned to build credibility early in the page flow

steps.description: Confirm animated counters show platform metrics
steps.context: At minimum: total URLs shortened, total clicks tracked

steps.description: Confirm counter animations trigger appropriately
steps.context: Animations should be performant and not cause layout shifts

test_cases.input: Statistics section renders on page load
test_cases.expected: Statistics section is visible with at least 2 metric counters (URLs shortened, clicks tracked)

test_cases.input: Counter animation triggers on scroll into view
test_cases.expected: Numbers animate from 0 to target value smoothly
Displays formatted numbers with appropriate icons for each metric
Statistics values are accessible to assistive technologies

steps.description: Scroll to the testimonials section

steps.description: Confirm at least 3 testimonials are displayed with proper attribution

scenarios.name: How It Works Section

steps.context: Section helps visitors understand the service quickly

steps.context: Should be positioned early in the page flow for quick understanding

steps.description: Confirm 3-4 steps are displayed with icons and descriptions

test_cases.expected: 3-4 steps displayed with icons/illustrations and brief descriptions
Steps display vertically in a clear flow
Steps display horizontally or in grid layout

scenarios.name: FAQ Section Functionality

steps.context: FAQ addresses common concerns before registration

steps.description: Scroll to the FAQ section near the bottom of the page
steps.context: Section should be positioned to address final concerns before CTA

steps.description: Click/tap to expand and collapse FAQ items
steps.context: Accordion-style behavior with smooth animations

Item expands with smooth animation to show answer
Item collapses with smooth animation

FAQ items can be expanded/collapsed using keyboard
Questions cover: pricing, link expiration, analytics features, and security

steps.description: Return to homepage after login
steps.context: CTA should reflect logged-in state

steps.description: Confirm primary CTA shows 'Go to Dashboard'

scenarios.name: Accessibility Compliance
scenarios.description: Verify all new sections meet WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards

steps.description: Use automated tools to check for accessibility issues
steps.context: Lighthouse, axe-core, or similar tools

steps.description: Navigate entire homepage using only keyboard
steps.context: All interactive elements must be reachable and operable

steps.description: Check all text meets minimum contrast ratios
steps.context: 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text

steps.description: Navigate homepage using screen reader software
steps.context: Content should be announced correctly

test_cases.input: Tab through all interactive elements on homepage
test_cases.expected: All buttons, links, and form inputs receive focus in logical order
Clear visible focus indicator on all focusable elements
All text meets WCAG 2.1 AA contrast requirements (4.5:1 normal, 3:1 large)
Statistics values are accessible via aria-labels or live regions
Accordion uses proper aria-expanded, aria-controls attributes
Demo URL input has proper label association for screen readers

scenarios.name: Performance and Loading
scenarios.description: Verify homepage loads within 2 seconds and animations don't cause performance issues

steps.description: Load homepage and measure time to interactive
steps.context: Must be under 2 seconds on standard broadband

steps.description: Execute Lighthouse performance test
steps.context: Target score of 80+

steps.description: Scroll through page monitoring frame rate
steps.context: Animations should not cause jank or dropped frames

steps.description: Check that below-the-fold content is lazy loaded
steps.context: Reduces initial bundle and improves TTI

test_cases.expected: Time to Interactive under 2 seconds
Performance score of 80 or higher
Smooth scrolling with no layout shifts (CLS < 0.1)
Animations run at 60fps without jank
Below-fold sections lazy load when scrolling into view

scenarios.name: Demo Error Handling
scenarios.description: Verify the demo feature handles errors gracefully with user-friendly messages

steps.description: Load homepage and locate the interactive demo
steps.context: Demo should be accessible to all visitors

steps.description: Submit invalid input to trigger client-side validation
steps.context: Test client-side error handling

steps.description: Test behavior when API request fails
steps.context: Network or server errors should be handled gracefully

steps.description: Confirm error messages are user-friendly and actionable
steps.context: No technical jargon or stack traces shown to users

test_cases.expected: User-friendly error message: 'Please enter a valid URL'

test_cases.input: Submit URL when API returns 500 error
test_cases.expected: Graceful error message: 'Something went wrong. Please try again.'
Timeout error message displayed without crashing the component
Error messages are announced to screen readers via aria-live
User can retry submission after clearing the error state
